engine: PostgreSQL 16 Alpine in a local Docker fixture
case: Qualified direct enum query parameters under a same-named search_path collision
change: Extend the shadowed enum fixture with direct equality, IN and BETWEEN query parameters against enum_shadow_b.items while search_path resolves enum_shadow_a.status_kind.
contract: Explicitly qualified target enum equality, IN and BETWEEN comparisons accept text parameters and return the target row under a colliding search_path.
The returned column retains enum_shadow_b.status_kind as its native type, and the shadow schema row remains unchanged.
Inside a transaction, SET LOCAL search_path to enum_shadow_a keeps direct status = $1 inference bound to enum_shadow_b.status_kind when querying the target table.

A parameter used by both pg_typeof($1) and an enum comparison is ambiguous to native PostgreSQL PREPARE (42P08); the driver preserves that ambiguity when a text-typed fallback conflicts with the enum operator.
Explicitly casting the parameter to enum_shadow_b.status_kind resolves the diagnostic query and pg_typeof($1::enum_shadow_b.status_kind) reports that enum.
independent_oracle: PostgreSQL current_schema() before and after SET LOCAL, native PREPARE and driver query SQLSTATE 42P08, successful enum comparisons, pg_typeof results and exact rows from both schemas.
